entries.en: Gigi somehow manages to praise your handiwork and deeply offend Serendipity. In any case, both the guildmaster and her assistant judge the items fit for delivery. Take them to Robert outside the Goldsmiths' Guild.

entries.en: Robert is surprised to learn that the goldsmith who prepared his order was in fact you, not Mistress Serendipity. He apologizes for the misunderstanding, and mentions that he will be keeping his eye on you from now on. Return to the guildmaster and tell her that the commission is complete.
entries.fr: Vous avez pu livrer sa commande à Robert. À présent, retournez voir Serendipity à la guilde des orfèvres.
entries.ja: ロバートに依頼の品を渡すことができた彫金師ギルドの「セレンディピティー」に報告しよう。

entries.en:
While bemused at first, Serendipity quickly decides that Robert's mistake is proof of your tremendous growth as a goldsmith.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 20.
